name: temperature-deformation field
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中耦合表示路堤温度和变形分布的场。
usage_overview: 温度—变形场用于描述冻土地区路堤在长期冻融过程中，温度分布及其引起的空间位移随时间的共同演变，将热状态变化与路堤变形联系起来。

complete_examples.text: In addition, the initial calculation time of the temperature-deformation field is Jul.
In this work, the temperature-deformation field model of embankment in freeze soil region is established to analyze the thermal-mechanical behavior of embankment.
